test_title: PYST 37: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the given letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

#: DZT :: QMG: %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given: #: DZT :: QMG: %

Option 1) ​# = OYV, % = PYT → OYV: DZT :: QMG: PYT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5c79071c2ddb129531da1cdcb1aff4b1b47588fcb8e587b6845a2b3362aa5b2.png] 

Option 2) # = YPG, % = KUL → YPG: DZT :: QMG: KUL

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4257584d11298c6acd13ea43821e9609128a14b7c40603a7718b3eaec3bdcb3.png] 

Option 3) # = ZTY, % = VMH → ZTY: DZT :: QMG: VMH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04a986ffef7aff2459d2e3d2f349f636bea7014495bd2e1b35b96baae6352e15.png] 

Option 4) # = YUO, % = VRL → YUO: DZT :: QMG: VRL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db36ed7c0de9fc0733fc6b4dc3ee788324a84d7221b88f30624f9a451b371192.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

4d
